original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚被通缉前海军军官被指带人强占前妻房产
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据SaharaReporters报道，被尼日利亚经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）通缉的前海军财务主管、退役少将Tahir Yusuf Bio被指带领武装暴徒及便衣海军人员，闯入其前妻位于卡杜纳州扎里亚的房产，将妇女和儿童驱逐出去。报道称此举违反法院2022年5月20日颁布的临时禁令。警方和民防人员到场后未能制止，事件具体细节尚待核实。

location.site: Church Hill Avenue, Government Reserved Area (GRA), Sabon Gari
location.raw_text: Church Hill Avenue in the Government Reserved Area (GRA), Sabon Gari, Zaria, Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 前海军财务主管Tahir Yusuf Bio因涉嫌挪用约20亿奈拉被EFCC通缉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: declared wanted by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) over alleged diversion and laundering of about N2 billion

key_facts.fact: 据称他带领武装暴徒和便衣海军人员闯入前妻位于扎里亚的房产
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has again invaded his former wife's property in Zaria, Kaduna State with armed thugs and plainclothes naval personnel

key_facts.fact: 法院2022年5月20日颁布的临时禁令禁止被告干扰原告对该房产的占有
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The order was granted on May 20, 2022, by Hon. Justice K. Dabo of the High Court of Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 警方和NSCDC人员到场后未能采取行动制止
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: when the police and NSCDC personnel arrived, they could not do anything to stop Tahir and his alleged thugs

key_facts.fact: 视频显示家具等物品被扔到屋外，妇女儿童在路边哭泣
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mattresses, chairs, refrigerators, bags, clothes, cooking utensils and other belongings lie in a heap on the grass verge outside the fence, while women, children and sympathisers sit by the roadside

uncertainties: 事件细节主要依据SaharaReporters单一来源报道，尚缺乏独立交叉验证
涉案人员身份及便衣海军人员说法尚未获官方确认
警方和NSCDC未采取行动的原因尚不清楚
